name: Sterling-Nakamura Legal Evidence Preservation Kit LEPK-2
product_name: Sterling-Nakamura Legal Evidence Preservation Kit LEPK-2
description: A forensic evidence collection and preservation kit designed to maintain an unbroken chain of custody from crime scene to courtroom. The LEPK-2 includes tamper-evident collection bags with embedded blockchain verification chips, a portable evidence scanner that photographs and catalogs items with cryptographic timestamps, sterile collection tools, and a sealed transport case with environmental monitoring. Every action taken with the kit is logged to Sterling-Nakamura's Blockchain Governance Protocol, creating an immutable record that cannot be challenged in court.
legality: Licensed — law enforcement and legal professionals

specifications.verification: Any BGP node can verify evidence integrity

story_hooks: An LEPK-2's blockchain log revealed that evidence was accessed outside the documented chain of custody — someone with physical access tampered with the evidence and the kit recorded it.
A defense attorney has challenged the LEPK-2 system itself, arguing that blockchain-verified evidence creates an illusion of infallibility that prejudices juries against legitimate challenges.
